en: Psalms 104

p.src: 1  Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

en: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
u.src: 1  Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

en: 104:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

en: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
u.src: 2  He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

p.src: 3  He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

en: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.
u.src: 3  He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

p.src: 4  He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

en: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.
u.src: 4  He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

en: 104:4 or, angels

p.src: 5  He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

en: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.
u.src: 5  He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

p.src: 6  You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

en: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
u.src: 6  You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

p.src: 7  At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

en: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
u.src: 7  At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

p.src: 8  The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

en: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.
u.src: 8  The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

zh: 104:8 或譯：隨山上翻，隨谷下流

p.src: 9  You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

en: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.
u.src: 9  You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

p.src: 10  He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

en: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.
u.src: 10  He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

p.src: 11  They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

en: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
u.src: 11  They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

p.src: 12  The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

en: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.
u.src: 12  The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

p.src: 13  He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

en: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
u.src: 13  He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

p.src: 14  He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

en: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:
u.src: 14  He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

p.src: 15  wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

en: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.
u.src: 15  wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

p.src: 16  The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

en: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,
u.src: 16  The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

p.src: 17  where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

en: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
u.src: 17  where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

p.src: 18  The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

en: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.
u.src: 18  The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

p.src: 19  He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

en: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.
u.src: 19  He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

p.src: 20  You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

en: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.
u.src: 20  You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

p.src: 21  The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
u.src: 21  The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

p.src: 22  The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

en: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.
u.src: 22  The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

p.src: 23  Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

en: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.
u.src: 23  Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

p.src: 24  LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

en: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
u.src: 24  LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

p.src: 25  There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

en: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
u.src: 25  There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

p.src: 26  There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

en: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
u.src: 26  There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

p.src: 27  These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

en: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
u.src: 27  These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

p.src: 28  You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

en: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.
u.src: 28  You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

p.src: 29  You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

en: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
u.src: 29  You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

p.src: 30  You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

en: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
u.src: 30  You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

p.src: 31  Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

en: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.
u.src: 31  Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

p.src: 32  He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

en: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
u.src: 32  He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

p.src: 33  I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

en: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
u.src: 33  I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

p.src: 34  Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

en: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.
u.src: 34  Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

p.src: 35  Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

en: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 35  Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

en:
104:35 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
104:35 Hebrew: יה Yah
